manchete.resumo: It's turkey time, and if you want to watch a movie with the family, you'll probably pick something that reflects the holiday. But what if you just want a taste after eating all that stuffing? Well, for that, I have…
manchete.trecho: It's turkey time, and if you want to watch a movie with the family, you'll probably pick something that reflects the holiday. But what if you just want a taste after eating all that stuffing? Well, for that, I have assembled the best Thanksgiving scenes. That way, you can get your holiday celebration in while still having something else to watch that keeps your attention. Plus some filmmaking tips for you to learn while watching. Let's dive in. 1. Planes, Trains and Automobiles (1987) — "The Rental Car Counter" - YouTube www.youtube.com While the entire movie is a road-trip odyssey built around getting home for Thanksgiving, so technically it is a totally Thanksgiving movie, this scene kind of sums up how hard it is to get home for the holidays. This is a holiday when every American is on the move, so you're battling others to get what you want and what you need. John Hughes understands…

noticias.titulo: Base Design gives Visa a brand refresh "for the next generation"
noticias.resumo: Design agency Base Design has created a more compact version of credit card company Visa's logo and worked with Displaay Type Foundry on a new typeface, as part of a refresh of the brand's visual identity . While the…
noticias.trecho: Design agency Base Design has created a more compact version of credit card company Visa's logo and worked with Displaay Type Foundry on a new typeface, as part of a refresh of the brand's visual identity . While the 2021 Visa wordmark remains unchanged, the refresh included creating a shortened symbol for the brand, rolling out the new Visa Sans typeface, and creating a blocky hero graphic to market towards a younger generation. "When you’re working with a brand as iconic as Visa, the challenge isn't recognition – it's relevance," said Base Design executive creative director Min Lew. "Our ambition was to build on Visa's extraordinary equity while giving it a renewed sense of energy and expression, one that feels as relevant to the next generation as it does to the generations who have grown up with it." noticias.trecho: JOTAJOTA+ ORGANIZES TRAINING STUDIO AROUND FLUID CIRCULATION   Occupying 126 sqm, Movebon is a boutique training studio in Madrid designed by JOTAJOTA+ around a clear spatial division between an open workout area and private service facilities. Rather than altering the building’s primary structure, the studio organizes circulation fluidly around existing structural elements while facing the street through two large glazed panels that admit daylight and expose interior activity to the sidewalk. noticias.resumo: The Budapest-based illustrator fills her colourful drawings with curious characters and unexpected details, encouraging us to slow down and find joy in the everyday. Spend a few minutes in Réka Mátyás ’ portfolio, and…
noticias.trecho: The Budapest-based illustrator fills her colourful drawings with curious characters and unexpected details, encouraging us to slow down and find joy in the everyday. Spend a few minutes in Réka Mátyás ’ portfolio, and you’ll meet two spotty dogs gazing at each other across a green meadow, a polka-dot cat posing beside an equally polka-dot tabi shoe, and a woman with ladybugs crawling through her golden hair. Polka-dot sisters, three cats stretched out across a chocolate-brown page, and a figure cradling a birthday cake with a single lit candle appear. It all feels soft, warm and slightly odd, splashed in a playful palette of bubblegum pinks, grassy greens and buttery yellows. The Budapest-based illustrator and motion designer was born in Transylvania, Romania, and began her creative journey at university, where she studied Fine Arts and graduated with a BA in 2022. referencias.titulo: Kate Jenkins Whips Up Delicious ‘Knitalian’ Dishes in an Immersive Exhibition
referencias.resumo: From plates of ravioli and spaghetti to bottles of chianti and sardines springing from their tins, Kate Jenkins ‘ immersive art-meets-restaurant experience is something to really sink your teeth into. Known for her…
referencias.trecho: From plates of ravioli and spaghetti to bottles of chianti and sardines springing from their tins, Kate Jenkins ‘ immersive art-meets-restaurant experience is something to really sink your teeth into. Known for her realistic knitted foodstuffs , the Brighton-based artist and knitwear designer presents Kate’s Knitalian at Air Contemporary , inviting us to consider the (rather unexpected) mouthwatering possibilities of yarn. For the opening reception, visitors were required to reserve a spot much as one would do to book a table in a traditional restaurant, including two timed sittings. Everything from wheels of salami and tortellini to tiramisù and bottles of “Pinot Stitchio” fill the delicatessen experience in a celebration of Italian cuisine. bolhas.titulo: From Property to Pixels: Shenzhen’s New Topography of Museums
bolhas.resumo: Few cities have remade their cultural identity with the velocity of Shenzhen. Founded as a Special Economic Zone in 1980, the manufacturing hub has evolved into a tech powerhouse of 18 million residents with a median…
bolhas.trecho: Few cities have remade their cultural identity with the velocity of Shenzhen. Founded as a Special Economic Zone in 1980, the manufacturing hub has evolved into a tech powerhouse of 18 million residents with a median age of 32.5. 1 This youthful, domestic migrant demographic defines the local museum audience. Lacking existing institutional lineages, the city built its cultural topography within a single generation, shaped by municipal land allocation and shifting financial forces. Shenzhen’s early contemporary art museum sector relied on real-estate patronage, with developers using cultural venues as placemaking assets to lift surrounding property values. Following the 2021–22 property market correction, this leveraged model gave way to a fragmented institutional landscape run by state enterprises, retail developers, and big tech. bolhas.titulo: BAISHUI’s “A Rainforest of Data” Opens at Fosun Foundation, Shanghai
bolhas.resumo: From November 11 to December 6, Fosun Foundation presents “A Rainforest of Data,” a solo exhibition by artist BAISHUI in Shanghai. Curated by Cui Cancan, the exhibition spans the first-floor gallery and the fourth-floor…
bolhas.trecho: From November 11 to December 6, Fosun Foundation presents “A Rainforest of Data,” a solo exhibition by artist BAISHUI in Shanghai. Curated by Cui Cancan, the exhibition spans the first-floor gallery and the fourth-floor outdoor public space, featuring a selection of the artist’s recent works, including seven paintings and the large-scale installation Mirage. Exploring image generation, data logic, and the language of painting, the exhibition examines how painting redefines its modes of seeing in an era shaped by algorithms, artificial intelligence, and big data. Installation view of BAISHUI ’s Mirage , 2026, 1494 x 1415 x 452 cm, at Fosun Foundation, Shanghai, 2026. Courtesy the artist and Fosun Foundation.
